Clovis MVP－

Pre-Deposit Vaults

The Clovis Pre-deposit Vaults are the initial, cross-chain infrastructure allowing deposits across 10 EVM networks to earn immediate dual rewards (real yields and Clovis points).

Links

Role

Product Designer

Company

Yei Finance

Deliverable

RWD

Time

Q3 2025

[ What is Clovis ]

Clovis aims to create a shared cross-chain liquidity pool to solve the problem of fragmented, idle, and inefficient capital in DeFi, allowing funds to be used simultaneously for lending, trading, and bridging to maximize returns.

[ MVP ]

Pre-deposit vaults make up the first foundational product in the Clovis ecosystem

  • [ Functions ]

    Deposit, lock, and multiply your rewards

  • [ Market ]

    Allows early participants to pre-deposit assets from multiple chains and boost rewards via lock-up

    Learn more

    ＊ All figures are for demonstration purposes only. Actual amounts may vary.

    [ 1-1 ]

    Action Panel

    Input the pre-deposit quantity and select your lock-up duration. (Note: A longer lock-up grants a higher multiplier on your Clovis Points.)

    [ 1-2 ]

    Deposit Distribution

    Gain a clear overview of your asset distribution across different chains and maintain full control over your deposit ratios.

  • [ Portfolio ]

    Monitor asset performance, track real-time yields, and manage lock-up positions and rankings

    ＊ All figures are for demonstration purposes only. Actual amounts may vary.

    [ 2-1 ]

    Asset Management

    Displays every deposited asset, accumulated rewards or points, and the specific lock-up expiration dates.

    Once the lock-up period ends, you can choose to extend the duration or withdraw immediately.

    [ 2-2 ]

    Points Leaderboard

    A gamified mechanism designed to increase user stickiness and drive engagement through points accumulation, creating a sense of FOMO.

    [ 2-3 ]

    Referral Mechanism

    An incentive-driven feature. When someone uses your referral code to bind their account and deposits funds, you will earn X% of their points as a referral bonus

  • [ Transactions ]

    Review all transaction records and on-chain details

    ＊ All figures are for demonstration purposes only. Actual amounts may vary.

    [ 3-1 ]

    Filter by Chain

    Easily filter by specific networks to quickly locate relevant transaction history.
